data.long_meaning: In the Kikuyu language, Wanjiku is composed of two parts: Wan- (God) and Ji-ku (gift). This name is a reminder of God's blessings and divine presence in a person's life. The name Wanjiku carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Wanjiku usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Wanjiku total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
